WSL-PROJECT-006.summary: Project doctor can report ready when declared dependencies were not restored and node_modules contains ordinary Windows artifacts.
WSL-PROJECT-006.evidence: A black-box fixture with nonexistent Python and Node dependencies, a system-Python symlink at .venv/bin/python, and node_modules/.bin/tool.cmd returned rc=0, ok=true. The doctor did not prove the interpreter belonged to a venv, verify declared dependency restoration, or reject generic Windows Node shims; the schema also forced both stacks.

fix_delta.summary: The npm integrity gate now resolves the selected executable strictly before classification and execution, rejects broken or Windows-backed targets behind Linux-path symlinks, and still permits Linux-to-Linux symlinks.
fix_delta.verification: The round-three Red reproduced a /tmp npm symlink resolving to /mnt/c and proved the Linux-to-Linux control was healthy. Both focused symlink/integrity tests passed after the fix, followed by all 61 WSL environment tests in 126.010 seconds.

WSL-BASELINE-007.summary: The documented standalone pnpm installation path does not reliably satisfy the mandatory Corepack baseline.
WSL-BASELINE-007.evidence: The baseline required both corepack and pnpm while INSTALL only guaranteed node/npm and standalone pnpm. Node.js 25 no longer distributes Corepack, so a correctly installed Linux-native pnpm could remain permanently unhealthy under the doctor contract.

fix_delta.summary: Corepack is no longer a mandatory machine tool or supported baseline source. Linux-native pnpm remains mandatory as an external machine capability with an explicit, non-mutating provision handoff and synchronized documentation.
fix_delta.verification: A Node 25-style fixture with no Corepack and a Linux-native pnpm now passes the exact machine audit. Eight focused contract tests and the complete 59-test WSL suite passed; no package installation or network mutation occurred.
